subtitle: A real column, not a hypothetical one

caption: A real Snowsight Switch Role panel -- each role scoped to exactly what its function requires.

code:
CREATE MASKING POLICY email_mask
  AS (val STRING) RETURNS STRING ->
  CASE
    WHEN CURRENT_ROLE() IN
      ('DRIFTWOOD_COMPLIANCE','DRIFTWOOD_TRANSFORMER')
      THEN val
    ELSE REGEXP_REPLACE(val,'^(.)[^@]*(@.*)$','\\1***\\2')
  END;
caption: The stored value never changes -- only what the query returns, based on who's running it.
